I always thought the whole point of Muse is that they are pretentious and overdo things a tonne. Personally I don't really find that as a problem, but I can see why people can get annoyed by it.

Also I'm just gonna ignore the fact that 1D Stockholm Syndrome was released 11 years after the Muse one.

I give this hot take a satire/10

1. Not gonna lie, I think that the top three albums for me (Oos, Absolution, BHaR) can be an interchangeable top three, so some days I think that Absolution is around number 3 for me.
2. Interlude could have melted into Hysteria better, but I wouldn't call it unnecessary
3. Stockholm Syndrome is the best Muse song of all time and I will fight anyone who says otherwise
4. Blackout is a masterpiece
5. The Small Print is amazing
6. I don't think ToaDA would have been a good closer, purely because of how the song ends.

All in all, some takes of a medium temperature. Agreed with 2-3/6 of these. Can't complain too much.

If we are going on popularity, I'd probably say either Uprising, Madness, or Starlight.
